Maria (runtime): Quick heads-up: FP8 rollout looks fine for small seqs but we're seeing a 12-18% tail-latency hit on long-seq chat traces. Suspect continuous-batcher padding + KV cache shape mis-selecting INT8 fallback kernels. Logs attached.

Ashok: Can you paste kernel-selection logs? also which model / seq len distribution?

Maria (runtime): Pasted selector snippet from canary:
```
[selector] batch_id=421 shape(B=6,S=1024,pad_ratio=0.41) chosen=int8_pack_v2 reason=shape_mismatch est_fp8=38ms est_int8=34ms pad=0.41 kv_slices=3
[selector] batch_id=422 shape(B=8,S=512,pad_ratio=0.37) chosen=int8_pack_v2 reason=shape_mismatch est_fp8=22ms est_int8=18ms pad=0.37 kv_slices=2
```

Kevin: That's the new packing heuristic kicking in — if KV cache stride != contiguous we fall back to the int8_pack kernels. Do we have telemetry for pad-waste distribution across workloads?

Maria (runtime): Perf counters from canary run (summary): pad_waste=0.42, avg_batch_size=6.7, kv_slices=3, memcpy_us spike on tail. Trace snippets: `kselector: chosen=int8_pack_v2 reason=shape_mismatch pad=0.42`

Tara: Possible quick mitigation: relax strict shape equality and prefer FP8 kernel when pad_waste < 0.5 AND est_fp8 <= est_int8 * 1.05. Also add a fast-path when kv_slices > 1 but slice sizes are small.

Devon: I can repro locally — which commit on canary?

Maria (runtime): Canary ref: `release/quant-rollout@d3f4c2` Repro harness: `tests/perf/continuous_batcher/long_seq.sh --model=llama2-13b --quant=fp8 --seqs 512 1024 1536`

CI-Bot: Perf job queued: perf/eng-runtime/1864503210 on `dedicated-us-east-2` (A100s).

Kevin: Long-term we should add a KV-slice cost model to the selector. Quick formula idea: effective_tokens = seq_len * (1 - pad_ratio) + kv_slice_penalty; pick kernel with lowest estimated cycles. Also include memcpy cost for non-contiguous slices.

Ashok: Also flag to watch: calibration shifts for FP8 on long prefixes — if scales drift we might see quality anomalies. Any sentinel eval alerts?

Maria (runtime): No quality alerts from sentinel evals yet — this looks perf-only. I'll attach pprof + nvprof traces to the ticket after CI finishes.

Tara: If CI confirms regression revert the heuristic on canary and ship selector patch next sprint. @Kevin can you open a PR with microbench results?

Kevin: Yep. I'll add a `kselector.debug_shape` flag that dumps decision stats (pad_ratio, kv_slices, chosen_kernel) to telemetry. Will include microbench numbers comparing fp8 vs int8 for common shapes. ETA EOD.

Devon: Running microbench now against d3f4c2 canary. Will post numbers in ~45m.

CI-Bot: Perf job finished: regression=+13% tail latency at seq=1024 for fp8 path. Report: https://perf.redwood/internal/1864503210 (internal)

Maria (runtime): :thumbsup: thanks everyone. Assigning follow-ups in linear thread. Kevin — once PR is up I'll drop traces in #eng-runtime-perf and we can A/B the selector change on canary.

(End of thread)
